name: com.amircollider.unitydirecttmp
description:
Point TextMeshPro at a .ttf and stop building font assets.

Pick a font file in Window ▸ Unity DirectTMP. Every TextMeshPro label in the project is drawn from it — in the Editor, in Play mode and in the build. Glyphs are rasterized the first time they are drawn, so there is no character set to choose in advance and no atlas to rebuild.

• One font file, every label. No component on any GameObject, nothing written into any scene.
• Persian, Arabic and Urdu that actually read — letters joined and in reading order. The joined shapes are taken from the font's OWN OpenType tables, so modern faces that carry no legacy presentation codepoints (Vazirmatn, Sahel, Shabnam, IRANSans, Noto Sans Arabic) join correctly. Verified glyph-for-glyph against HarfBuzz.
• Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Cyrillic, Thai, Greek and symbols with no setup at all.
• Rich-text tags are never shaped or reordered.
• Text is shaped on its way to being drawn, through TextMeshPro's own ITextPreprocessor, so your label.text reads back exactly as you set it.

Free and MIT licensed. Requires TextMeshPro (bundled with Unity). No other dependencies.

samples.description: One scene, one font, twelve languages — English, CJK, Persian, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Hindi and emoji, all from a single .ttf.
